items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Hector Fontana had a group over there... I don't know if Hector Fontana's band participated in the parade

ctx.x: Were there any other bands from new audience down there?
Yeah, they had, Hector Fontana had a group over there and, oh this one boy was playing over at the dream room, not the dream room, a famous duo. Trumpet player?
